ItemGroupDef.Name: AE
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per adverse event per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Adverse Events domain contains data about untoward medical occurrences.

ItemGroupDef.Name: CE
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per event per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Clinical Events domain for disease-related events not captured in AE.

ItemGroupDef.Name: CM
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per medication per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Concomitant Medications domain captures prior and concomitant medication data.

ItemGroupDef.Name: CO
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per comment per subject

ItemGroupDef.Name: DD
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per subject death

Description.TranslatedText: Death Details captures detailed information about subject death.

ItemGroupDef.Name: DM
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Demographics domain contains subject-level demographic information.

ItemGroupDef.Name: DS
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per disposition status per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Disposition domain captures subject disposition and protocol milestones.

ItemGroupDef.Name: DV
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per deviation per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Protocol Deviations domain captures protocol deviation information.

ItemGroupDef.Name: EC
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per protocol-specified study treatment per subject per date

Description.TranslatedText: Exposure as Collected captures data as collected on the CRF.

ItemGroupDef.Name: EX
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per constant-dosing interval per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Exposure domain captures study treatment administration data.

ItemGroupDef.Name: FA
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per finding about per parent record per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Findings About captures additional info about Events or Interventions.

ItemGroupDef.Name: IS
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per specimen assessment per time point per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Immunogenicity Specimen captures anti-drug antibody assessments.

ItemGroupDef.Name: LB
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per lab test per time point per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Laboratory Test Results domain captures central and local lab data.

ItemGroupDef.Name: MH
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per medical history event per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Medical History domain captures subject's medical history.

ItemGroupDef.Name: PC
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per concentration per time point per subject

Description.TranslatedText: PK Concentrations domain captures drug concentration measurements.

ItemGroupDef.Name: PP
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per PK parameter per subject

Description.TranslatedText: PK Parameters domain captures derived PK parameters.

ItemGroupDef.Name: QS
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per questionnaire item per time point per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Questionnaires domain captures PRO and clinician-reported outcomes.

ItemGroupDef.Name: RELREC
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per related record relationship

Description.TranslatedText: Related Records domain links records between domains.

ItemGroupDef.Name: RS
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per response assessment per time point per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Disease Response domain captures tumor response assessments.

ItemGroupDef.Name: SC
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per characteristic per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Subject Characteristics for additional subject-level data.

ItemGroupDef.Name: SE
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per actual Element per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Subject Elements describes actual Elements through which the subject passed.

ItemGroupDef.Name: TA
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per planned Element per Arm

Description.TranslatedText: Trial Arms domain describes each planned Arm in the trial.

ItemGroupDef.Name: TE
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per planned Element

Description.TranslatedText: Trial Elements domain describes basic building blocks of trial design.

ItemGroupDef.Name: TR
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per tumor assessment per time point per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Tumor Results domain captures tumor identification and measurements.

ItemGroupDef.Name: TS
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per trial summary parameter value

Description.TranslatedText: Trial Summary domain describes overall trial information.

ItemGroupDef.Name: TU
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per tumor identified per subject

Description.TranslatedText: Tumor Identification domain captures tumor/lesion characteristics.

ItemGroupDef.Name: TV
ItemGroupDef.def:Structure: One record per planned Visit per Arm

Description.TranslatedText: Trial Visits domain describes planned study visits.
